messages.author: Ingrid Solberg
messages.text:
Analysis of unity_video_retarget, as asked in #ua-team. Install dates 2026-06-01 -> 2026-07-15, D1-mature cohorts.

Before (Jun 1 - Jul 8): spend ~$2.56k/day, ~2.2k installs/day, CPI $1.15, CTR 1.6%, click->install 34%, D1 34%.
After (Jul 13 - 15, after a 4-day ramp from Jul 9): spend ~$2.6k/day, ~5.1k installs/day, CPI ~$0.50, CTR ~8.0%, click->install ~16%, D1 ~15%.

Sister campaign unity_playable_installs: no change on any metric.
Reading: a flood of clicks plus extra installs that never come back. Textbook click spam / install fraud. Revenue per day hasn't changed, so the 'cheap' installs add nothing. Checks: ua_spend aggregated to cohort grain matches cohorts.installs for this campaign, no fan-out.

replies.author: Daniel Esposito
replies.text: Convincing. I was ready to put +50% on this :grimacing:

replies.author: Kwame Asante
replies.text: Click-to-install time distribution in Attributa also shows a big bump of very long CTIT installs from this campaign since Jul 9. Matches click flooding.

replies.author: Ingrid Solberg
replies.text: Thanks Kwame. I'll footnote the campaign in the weekly report from now on.
